name: Example Weather
description: Forecasts and current conditions for any city
author: Example Author

connect.api: GET /forecast?q=<city> returns a 5-day forecast; GET /now?q=<city> the current conditions.
help: Sign in at weather.example.com and open Account → API keys.
Make a key and paste it here.
connect.blurb: Looks up forecasts for the places you ask about.
